[[Sinvahn]] is a [[Vabbi]]an noble found wandering around on the first floor, in the northern section of the [[Garden of Seborhin]]'s central plaza.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Garden of Seborhin}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Ahai. Isn't this the most beautiful garden? My cousin, [[Ling]], always asks me to send her flowers for her prince. I think she calls him an "emperor." Well, anyway, she tells me he always gives her the nicest cards."''

==Notes==
*She is the cousin of [[Ling]], a Canthan florist.
